long_biography.plain_text:
For Steve Wedlock, teaching seamanship included running an entire school programme at sea. As co-founder and co-director of Watermark, he led academic voyages for dyslexic teenagers, combining navigation and boat handling with a school year afloat. He subsequently directed New England Historic Seaport, developing programmes ranging from urban youth activities to college semesters at sea.

His collaboration with writer Steve Dean brought maritime experience into fiction. Their League of Maritime Adventurers series follows a group of teenagers on the Maine coast. Wedlock supplied the setting and nautical knowledge, while Dean brought experience in fantasy and adventure writing. Wedlock also devised the short maritime facts placed between chapters.
